title: The empty Inactive tab message does not flash while the list is still loading
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). QAPL-I1…I3 are inactive at Staging Heavy Duty. Staging Lethbridge has no inactive parts: GET /api/inventory/parts?status=inactive with X-Location-ID = Staging Lethbridge returns 200 with an empty collection (if QAPL-I1 is inactive there, activate it at Lethbridge for this test and set it back afterwards). DevTools Network tab open with throttling set to Slow 3G; set it back to No throttling after the test.
custom_steps:
1. At Staging Heavy Duty open /parts/inventory, click the Inactive tab and watch the list until GET /api/inventory/parts?status=inactive completes.
  2. Still on the Inactive tab, switch the location to Staging Lethbridge and watch the list until the request completes.
  3. Click the Active tab, then the Inactive tab again, and watch until the inactive list request completes.
  4. Still on the Inactive tab, switch the location back to Staging Heavy Duty and watch until the request completes.
custom_expected:
1. While the request is pending "No inactive parts at this location." never shows; after it completes QAPL-I1, QAPL-I2 and QAPL-I3 are listed and the message is absent.
  2. The Inactive tab is kept and the list reloads; the message does not show while the request is pending; once the empty response arrives text_no_inactive_parts reads "No inactive parts at this location."
  3. The message does not appear while the request is pending; it shows only after the empty list has loaded.
  4. The message does not show at any point during the reload; QAPL-I1…I3 appear when the response arrives.
